## See also

* [strazactl](/reference/cli/strazactl/): Straza admin CLI
* [strazactl policy activate](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_policy_activate/): Publish one PolicySet's stored text after the server's checks, leaving every other set as published
* [strazactl policy apply](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_policy_apply/): Upload PolicySet YAML: a new set is stored off, and edits to a live set wait for policy activate
* [strazactl policy deactivate](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_policy_deactivate/): Turn a PolicySet off and recompile and distribute the snapshot
* [strazactl policy delete](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_policy_delete/): Delete a PolicySet that is off (turn a live one off first)
* [strazactl policy diff](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_policy_diff/): Diff the stored PolicySet against a local file
* [strazactl policy list](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_policy_list/): List stored PolicySets
* [strazactl policy show](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_policy_show/): Print a stored PolicySet: its story on stderr, the YAML alone on stdout
* [strazactl policy simulate](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_policy_simulate/): Ask what a call would do for a subject, against the live policies
* [strazactl policy validate](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_policy_validate/): Validate PolicySet YAML files locally against the v1beta1 spec
